beat: Sunday 9 PM: John and Dhika arrive for horror-film outing; Sharmi's appearance triggers sari joke

lines.original: Around 9 PM at night... Dhika came back into her house after putting Pappu to sleep in aunty's house.....
lines.local: Raat kareeb nau baje Dhika, Pappu ko Aunty ke ghar sulaakar apne ghar lauti.

lines.original: John: dear.... your phone has been beeing for a while now..
lines.local: John: Dear, tumhara phone kaafi der se baj raha hai.

lines.original: Dhika: oh...looking at it..its only Sharmi... looks like they reached the mall already.. shall we leave John ?
lines.local: Dhika phone dekhkar: Oh, bas Sharmi hai. Lagta hai woh mall pahunch gaye. John, hum bhi chalein?

lines.original: John and Dhika started to the mall for the movie date with Raj and Sharmi... not exactly a date but thats what Shami has been calling it....
lines.local: John aur Dhika, Raj aur Sharmi ke saath movie dekhne mall chale. Sharmi ise mazaak mein 'date' keh rahi thi, haalanki yeh asal mein waisi date nahi thi.

lines.original: They reached the mall...and were about to reach the front of the theater when suddenly someone grabbed and hugged John from behind....
lines.local: Mall mein theatre ke saamne pahunchne hi waale the ki kisi ne peeche se John ko pakadkar hug kiya.

lines.original: Wheeling around in surprise,..he saw Sharmi............. dressed to kill. Sharmi may not have the assets which Dhika is blessed with but Sharmi does know how to make herself hot.
lines.local: Hairaan hokar ghooma toh Sharmi thi—bahut striking outfit mein. Dhika jaisi body proportions na hote hue bhi Sharmi apne aap ko stylish aur attractive present karna jaanti thi.

lines.original: She was wearing a pair of short trousers which ended an inch above her mid thighs and a lace type shirt which was see-through in front of her stomach but had an extra layer of cloth in her breast area.... The shirt was low cut but not showing much cleavage....... The best part of her entire attire was the red hot lipstick she wore on her juicy lips.
lines.local: Usne mid-thigh se kareeb ek inch upar khatam hote short trousers aur lace-style shirt pehni thi. Pet ke saamne shirt see-through tha, lekin breast area par kapde ki extra layer thi; low-cut neck par zyada cleavage nahi dikh raha tha. Bright-red lipstick uske look ka sabse noticeable hissa tha.

lines.original: Today, she looked like a hot sizzler served on a platter.
lines.local: Aaj Sharmi hot sizzler ki tarah lag rahi thi—narrator uske striking appearance ko emphasize karta hai.

lines.original: Dhika noticed John gorging Sharmi inch by inch and gave him a touch knock on his stomach.....
lines.local: Dhika ne John ko Sharmi ko sir se pair tak dekhte notice kiya aur uske pet par halka sa thapka diya.

lines.original: Shamri: hehe... sweetie, why are you beating him... let him see the beauty.... she made a casual move and present herself...
lines.local: Sharmi: Hehe, sweetie, kyun maar rahi ho? Use beauty dekhne do! Usne mazaak mein pose diya.

lines.original: Dhika:uhnn.. he will see you whole day if I let him..... .what if Raj sees, poor fellow...
lines.local: Dhika: Uhnn... mera bas chale toh yeh poora din tumhe dekhta rahega. Raj ne dekh liya toh bechara kya sochega?

lines.original: Sharmi: hehe.... he won't mind... besides, he is used to me flirting with others... hehe.. and moreover, more than these dresses, he has a thing for women who wear saree,... especially that go contrast to their skin....
lines.local: Sharmi: Hehe, usse bura nahi lagega, meri flirting ki use aadat hai. Waise in kapdon se zyada use aisi auratein pasand hain jo apni skin ke contrast mein sari pehenti hain.

lines.original: John: uhnnn Dhika, how hard did you hit... and then grinning a bit, Sharmi, did you say a thing for women in saree that go contrast to their skin...
lines.local: John: Uhnn, Dhika, kitna zor se maara! Phir grinning: Sharmi, tumne contrast-colour sari waali baat kahi?

lines.original: Noticing both John and Sharmi grinning on her, she looked down to see that was exactly what she was wearing...
lines.local: Dono ko apni taraf muskuraate dekh Dhika ne neeche dekha: usne bilkul waisi hi sari pehni thi.
